name: ao-pr-testing
summary: Configures the opt-in AO pull-request review workflow and OpenShift MCP integration.

lifecycle.idempotency: Reconciles only the named AO workflow, MCP integration, and owned AAP records.
lifecycle.failure_boundary: Stops before webhook or workflow creation when AO, MCP, or reviewed source-control configuration is unavailable.

readiness: The owned MCP integration is reachable from AO.
The review workflow is present but is not launched automatically.

security.secret_storage: Source-control credentials must be supplied through reviewed AAP credential handling and are never recorded in the contract.
security.network_trust: AAP and MCP connections retain configured TLS trust.
security.external_actions: No pull request comment, webhook delivery, or workflow run occurs without an external event.
